coverageSemantics: placesCovered identifies the datum geography; sourceCoverage is source footprint, never a claim of distinct estimates for all places. National rows are national benchmarks, not a calibrated state matrix.
Empty coverage indicates a foreign comparison; legal federal rows may cover applicable jurisdictions while eligibility exceptions remain separate.

rowConventions.spread: populationJan2026Low to populationJan2026High; scenario range, not sampling CI.
rowConventions.missingGeoid: PR78 municipio rows join through roadmap-r11-pr-municipio-geoid-join.json; never use an empty ID as a shared identity.

rowConventions.placesCovered: Original row code is FIPS; map through jurisdictionFipsToCode.
rowConventions.boundClarification: E* plus F* covers current operations plus construction only, not all capital outlay (G* other capital omitted). Its0..E+F bound applies only to the eligible-procurement subset of those included expenditures; it is NOT an upper bound on all procurement or a vendor-local share.

rowConventions.terms: Federal public statistical work17USC105; termsURL column.
rowConventions.placesCovered: Column lists both origin and destination coverage (same-state pair has one code). Verify by mapping originGeoid[:2] and destinationGeoid[:2] through jurisdictionFipsToCode and deduplicating. State GEOIDs have two digits; county GEOIDs five.
rowConventions.spread: Blank means not computed, never zero uncertainty.
rowConventions.estimateStatus: false means published aggregate transcription, not a complete or population-representative person-flow estimate.

publisherEstimateConvention: Across earlier files, isEstimate=false often means a directly transcribed publisher statistic; it does not assert no sampling error. Census population estimates, survey means, regression estimates and HPI are publisher estimates. isEstimate=true marks author extrapolation/derived scenarios and some Census weighted aggregates; consult source design and supplied spread before use.
adoption: Apply these column aliases and coverage corrections, and the specific verified-file supersessions linked in the handoff, before loading any data. No synthetic value fills an explicit gap.
